verdict.rationale: The founder describes Zero as an AI-powered email client that auto-categorizes mail, summarizes threads, drafts replies, and lets users chat with their inbox, which covers in-product AI insights and suggestions from the user's own email. The repo's MCP docs also list asking questions about mailbox content and threads and AI-assisted composing, though those are framed as MCP capabilities rather than in-app features. Missing for 10: first-party product documentation of the in-app AI features (summaries, categorization, inbox chat), and independent hands-on corroboration of insight and suggestion quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
